entities.name: Özlem Özçelik
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Özlem Özçelik-İşseven is a Turkish volleyball player. She is 190 cm tall and played as a middle blocker. Özlem played 312 times for the national team. She also played for Vakıfbank Güneş Sigorta, Emlak Bankası, Tuborg, Eczacıbaşı, Fenerbahçe Acıbadem, Türk Telekom, Galatasaray Medical Park in Turkey and Dynamo Moscow in Russia.
